title: Topic 9
japanese_text:
A：私がBさんだけに話したあのこと、この前の飲み会でみんなに話したそうですね。<u>プライベートな</u>ことまで言うなんて…。<u>侮辱して</u>ますよ。
B：<u>面目</u>ない。かなり酔ってて記憶も<u>あやふやな</u>んだ…。酔って話すなんて<u>軽率だった</u>と思う。本当にごめん。
english_translation: A: I heard that you told everyone at the drinking party the other day about that thing I only told you. I can't believe you'd talk about something so private... It's an insult. B: I have no excuse. I was pretty drunk and my memory is hazy... I think it was thoughtless of me to talk while drunk. I'm really sorry.
